prayerExcerpt.en-US: By fulfilling our duties on earth, we may seek out your eternal Kingdom.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Desempenhando as nossas tarefas temporais, busquemos o vosso reino eterno.

meta.face: A tall, slender man of about forty with a LONG, NARROW oval face — a high, smooth forehead, a fine, straight, slender nose, wide-set light-blue eyes under pale, level brows, slightly hollow cheeks under fine cheekbones, a small gentle mouth and a long, narrow chin; clean-shaven, straight ash-blond hair with the first grey, cut level at the jaw under the crown, and a serene, gracious gaze lowered to the relic.
meta.basis: Salimbene, who saw him in 1248, called him slender and tall with an angelic face; the thirteenth-century images (the Wikipedia lead miniature, consulted) show him beardless with fair hair to the jaw. Made about forty, long-faced and greying, to keep him apart from the youthful blond Martin and George.

sources.title: Louvre, Portrait du roi Louis IX
